text: Το γράμμα {1} χθες από τον δήμο.

translation.en: The letter was sent yesterday by the municipality.

explain.en: The letter does not send; it is sent: passive aorist στάλθηκε (formal: εστάλη). «από τον δήμο» names who did it.
explain.tr: Mektup göndermez, gönderilir: edilgen geçmiş zaman στάλθηκε (resmî: εστάλη). «από τον δήμο» eylemi kimin yaptığını söyler.

text: Στη γειτονιά μας τα σκουπίδια {1} κάθε Τρίτη και Παρασκευή.

translation.en: In our neighbourhood the rubbish is collected every Tuesday and Friday.
translation.tr: Mahallemizde çöpler her salı ve cuma toplanır.

explain.en: Plural subject (τα σκουπίδια) and a habit (κάθε Τρίτη): present passive, 3rd person plural, μαζεύονται.
explain.tr: Çoğul özne (τα σκουπίδια) ve bir alışkanlık (κάθε Τρίτη): şimdiki zaman edilgen, 3. çoğul şahıs, μαζεύονται.

text: Η αίτησή σας {1} και θα σας ενημερώσουμε σύντομα.

translation.en: Your application has been received and we will inform you soon.
translation.tr: Başvurunuz alındı, yakında size bilgi vereceğiz.

explain.en: The application is received: passive aorist παραλήφθηκε. This is the usual wording of an office reply.
explain.tr: Başvuru alınır: edilgen geçmiş zaman παραλήφθηκε. Resmî dairelerin cevaplarında sık geçen bir ifadedir.

text: Αν {1} νωρίς αύριο, θα πάμε μαζί στην εφορία.

translation.en: If you come early tomorrow, we will go to the tax office together.
translation.tr: Yarın erken gelirsen vergi dairesine birlikte gideriz.

explain.en: A single future event after αν takes the perfective form without θα: αν έρθεις …, θα πάμε.
explain.tr: αν'dan sonra gelecekteki tek bir olay θα olmadan tamamlanmış biçimle söylenir: αν έρθεις …, θα πάμε.

text: Ο υπάλληλος μου είπε ότι η κάρτα μου {1} έτοιμη την Παρασκευή.

translation.en: The clerk told me that my card would be ready on Friday.
translation.tr: Memur bana kartımın cuma günü hazır olacağını söyledi.

explain.en: Reported speech with ότι keeps the clerk's future: «θα είναι έτοιμη». θα ήταν is also correct.
explain.tr: ότι ile dolaylı anlatım memurun gelecek zamanını korur: «θα είναι έτοιμη». θα ήταν da doğrudur.
